applicant.name: Mag. Dr. Clemens Auer
applicant.organisation: Cardiomed Pharma Austria GmbH, medical affairs

purpose: Medical education for cardiologists: we want to know in which regions few heart failure patients receive a beta blocker, so that our field team can organise sponsored dinners and symposia that introduce our new heart failure drug to the local specialists.
question: How many patients with heart failure have an active beta blocker prescription, by region?
definitions: Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Beta blocker = ATC code starting with C07.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: patients with heart failure and patients with heart failure on an active beta blocker.
